text:
Alex R: Quick heads-up — I'm about to merge a passive rollout for a per-model 'delta-cost' column in the cost dashboard. :eyes:
Sam T: Nice. Does that column include cache savings attribution?
Alex R: It currently shows raw token delta between model variants + batching/quantization estimates. cache savings are NOT attributed yet.
Maria P: FYI we saw a mismatch in staging: sticky routing + fallback to a cheaper SKU caused cache credits to be earned on the old pool and not show up for the tenant in the same window. tenant saw higher net cost even though system saved tokens.
Devon K: I reproduced — if session affinity moves due to pool churn, the credit goes to pool-id and our per-tenant aggregation misses it. result: negative "savings" for tenant in that epoch.
Jen L: From a UX/PM perspective we need two things: (1) surface an "approx attributed cache savings" with a confidence level, (2) explain the methodology in the tooltip so customers know why numbers can go negative.
Alex R: Agreed. Proposal: attribute cache credits first to route-fingerprint (prefix hash) then split to tenants by their session-weight within an attribution window. window defaults to 5m but configurable via API.
Sam T: Can you paste a quick SQL sketch for the attribution?
Alex R: ```sql
-- sketch: assign cache credits by fingerprint then proportional split
with pool_credits as (
  select fingerprint, sum(credits) as pool_credits
  from cache_events
  where ts >= now() - interval '1 hour'
  group by fingerprint
), session_weights as (
  select tenant_id, fingerprint, sum(session_toks) as weight
  from invocations
  where ts >= now() - interval '1 hour'
  group by tenant_id, fingerprint
)
select s.tenant_id, p.fingerprint,
       p.pool_credits * (s.weight / sum(s.weight) over (partition by p.fingerprint)) as attributed_credit
from pool_credits p
join session_weights s on s.fingerprint = p.fingerprint;
```
Maria P: That looks reasonable for a first pass. We should also include a fallback rule: if session weight is tiny, attribute to global pool rather than spike tenant bills.
Devon K: Also watch perf — joining large invocation tables hourly could be expensive. Maybe approximate with sampled windows or pre-aggregated materialized views.
Alex R: Good point. We'll add a matview on 1m shard and sample 10% of sessions for low-cost estimation.
Jen L: For console UX, let's add a small badge: "est. attribution" and hover shows method + sampling rate + confidence band. Ops should be able to toggle attribution off for exact pool-level billing.
Sam T: API change suggestion: add query param crediting_window_seconds and attribution_mode ("route_first" | "pool_only" | "tenant_proportional"). Example: `GET /costs?crediting_window_seconds=300&attribution_mode=route_first`
Alex R: We'll implement server-side flag and expose in the advanced panel. Also will emit a telemetry event `cost.attribution.method` with sampling metadata so we can track diffs.
CostBot: Automated check — note that any change to attribution logic will affect billing previews. Flagging billing-team for FYI. :rotating_light:
Jen L: Thanks. Action items: Devon will prototype matview + sample, Sam to wire API param and console toggle, Alex to add tooltip text and telemetry. I'll coordinate doc copy.
Devon K: I'll own the prototype, will post results in #eng-platform in ~48h.
Alex R: perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
